route: extracted public runtime from candidate ZIP; original input copied to Kingdom_Data; actual Onion launch_standalone.sh -> knl.sh -> importer -> game
swap_note: Process swap at completion, not peak swap. Device had Onion swap enabled.
restoration: Onion MainUI resumed and prior ondemand governor restored. The attempted audioserver -8 restart failed with MI_AO_SetPubAttr while MainUI retained the audio device; the idle device was rebooted after QA to restore the normal boot audio state.
limits: Audio output muted in boot. Interruption on device used SIGTERM; activation-boundary recovery is synthetic, not a physical power-cut or disk-full injection. A later SSH audio smoke test fell back to headless audio; it does not verify audible output. Normal frontend audio needs gameplay verification.
